matches.rationale: Ground truth concerns cherry-picked VBench scores (83.74 vs 83.24) without statistical evidence. No finding addresses this VBench discrepancy; Finding 1 is about a speedup inconsistency (10× vs 32×).
Both identify the same scientific flaw in Equation (2): the likelihood factorization lacks conditioning on previous clips, contradicting the described inter‑clip autoregressive generation.
Ground truth criticizes missing train/validation splits and dataset bias information. Finding 3 notes unused references [7] and [15]; these are completely different issues.
Ground truth notes incomplete reporting of prompt rewriting use and missing confidence intervals for VBench comparisons. No finding discusses prompt rewriting or VBench confidence intervals.

Ground truth points out unfair experimental design (different resolutions and parameter counts) in the efficiency comparison table. Finding 1 flags a numeric inconsistency in speedup claims (10× vs 32×), not design fairness.
Ground truth challenges the 'first discrete autoregressive 720p video generator' claim as an exaggeration. No finding addresses this claim.
Ground truth says SQD dropout probabilities and loss adjustments are unspecified. No finding mentions SQD or these missing details.
Ground truth flags omission of ethical review, consent, or bias discussion. No finding covers ethical or data‑compliance concerns.
Ground truth argues the conclusion overstates superiority and ignores stated limitations. No finding addresses this overstatement.
Ground truth identifies hyperbolic promotional language in the introduction. No finding discusses rhetorical tone or manipulative phrasing.
Ground truth describes ambiguity and inconsistency about temporal vs. spatial scale extension in the method. No finding addresses temporal‑modeling coherence.
Ground truth notes missing confidence intervals/significance tests for GenEval and DPG scores. No finding discusses these benchmarks or statistical rigor.
Ground truth cites fabricated references ([1],[8],[28],[39] with 2025 dates). Finding 3 points to unused references [7] and [15]; different reference numbers and different error type.
Ground truth criticizes over-promotional language about spacetime sparse attention lacking trade-off discussion. No finding addresses this section or overclaim.
Ground truth notes missing optimizer, weight decay, scheduler, and hardware details. No finding mentions missing training hyperparameters or reproducibility details.
Ground truth says zero-shot video extrapolation relies only on qualitative examples without quantitative evaluation. No finding discusses this qualitative-only evidence.
